question: Who received a gold medal for choreography for the Ballet Folklorico of Mexico?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mrinalini Sarabhai.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer to the question is** option 4, Mrinalini Sarabhai**, who received a** gold medal **for choreography for the** Ballet Folklorico of Mexico.**
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai was an **Indian classical dancer** and **choreographer**, who was known for her contributions to the development of the** classical dance form of Bharatanatyam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jatin Goswami **was an** Indian theatre director, actor, and playwright,** known for his contributions to the theatre scene in** Assam and Northeast India.**
 
• **Alarmel Valli** is a **Bharatanatyam dancer** and **choreographer** from **Chennai**, who has received several awards and accolades for her contributions to the field of classical dance.
 
• **Amala Akkineni** is an Indian** film actress and dancer**, who has worked in **Telugu and Tamil films,** and has also been involved in social and environmental causes.
 
• Hence, the statement is** correct **that Mrinalini Sarabhai received a gold medal for choreography for the Ballet Folklorico of Mexico.
